name: Yorkshire Sculpture Park
funding: Core funding from Arts Council England, Wakefield Council, Roger Evans, the Liz and Terry Bramall Foundation and Dunard Fund. Corporate partners: HSBC, Sandal MINI and BMW, Luscombe Drinks, Archivist.
watch: The ASA banned two HSBC climate adverts in October 2022; HSBC is a current corporate partner. No protest at YSP turned up.
records_note: No annual reports found; accounts are on the Charity Commission register, the Our supporters page names funders and partners undated, and trustees are listed.

name: YYZ Artists' Outlet
funding: Canada Council for the Arts, Ontario Arts Council, Toronto Arts Council; registered charity.
watch: Artist-run centre in 401 Richmond, founded in 1979, offering an alternative to commercial art galleries.

name: Z33
funding: Kunstenhuis of the Province of Limburg.
records_note: Names its twelve board members but shows partners only as undated logos and posts no annual report or accounts.

name: Zanabazar Museum of Fine Art
funding: Mongolian state museum (founded 1966) listed by the National Centre for Cultural Heritage; UNESCO preservation partner.
records_note: Its own site is down; parent body NCCH posts activity reports for 2006 to 2022 but no accounts, funders or board.

name: Zarya Centre for Contemporary Art
funding: Private: founded 2013 by Alexander Mechetin, founder and co-owner of spirits group Novabev (ex-Beluga Group) — alcohol money, allowed.
watch: Announced in 2020 that main activity would shift to the Golubitskoye estate (Krasnodar), but the Vladivostok residency (2025 open call) and exhibitions (Sept 2026–Apr 2027 show with Smena) continue. OpenSanctions finds no entry for Mechetin.
records_note: Its partners page shows undated logos under three headings; the site posts no reports, accounts or board, and names no legal entity.

name: Galeria Zé dos Bois (ZDB)
funding: DGArtes (Ministério da Cultura), Lisbon City Council; non-profit cultural association.

name: Zeitz MOCAA
funding: Jochen Zeitz donated the collection he had loaned; sponsors include Gucci and BMW, the Mellon Foundation funds fellowships, and the board now pays.
watch: Public-private partnership in Cape Town's Grain Silo complex. Major funding from German business executive Jochen Zeitz (Puma/Kering) and South African commercial real estate REITs; independent board of trustees.
records_note: Its supporters page names corporate members, founders and sponsors including the Mellon Foundation and BMW, undated, but it posts no reports, accounts or board.

name: Zolak
funding: Founders' private contributions, residency subscriptions, event rentals, a crypto bar and donations; states it does not take grants
watch: 150 m2 'micro art residence' and community venue at Vytenio g. 50D (former ELFA factory), opened 14 Jun 2025 by Piotr Markielau, Alina Nahornaja and Siarhei Hudzilin: residencies, screenings, discussions, coworking, raves, sauna.
records_note: Zolak's site lists spaces, prices and rules, with no annual report, accounts, funder names or board.
